Package org.apache.hadoop.ipc

Class CallerContext

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.ipc.CallerContext
@Public @Evolving public final class CallerContext extends Object
A class defining the caller context for auditing coarse granularity operations. This class is immutable.
